name: Kaijuu Kidan Oboro Juuya Kuuko Mangekyou
original_name: 怪獣綺譚 朧十夜 空狐万華鏡
source:
Shizune finds a mysterious kaleidoscope... the longer she peers into it the more she sees images of the past.
